csv_project_name: Consultant for BKT Bikeway Feasibility Study
csv_scope_of_work: The Greater Buffalo Niagara Regional Transportation Council (GBNRTC), the Metropolitan Planning Organization for Erie and Niagara Counties, is seeking qualified firms with experience in the planning, design, and construction of trails and bikeways. The scope of the project is to undertake a feasibility study for the development of the BKT Bikeway. The project extends along Kenmore Ave from the Tonawanda Rails to Trails path in the east, south along Military Rd, west along Skillen St, and southwest along Esser Ave. The project is listed as a priority corridor the 2020 Regional Bike Master Plan, and was submitted to GBNRTC for technical assistance jointly by the Town of Tonawanda and the City of Buffalo.
